text: Over the past two (2) years, consistent with our strategy, the Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) has designed and built Canada’s largest municipally owned Electric Vehicle (EV) charging network, featuring 461 charging ports across 85 locations. Over the next two (2) to three (3) years, Toronto Parking Authority will continue expanding its EV charging network, further solidifying its position as Toronto’s premier EV charging provider. The purpose of this paper is to seek approval for the extension of two (2) key agreements with EV charging equipment providers, ChargePoint Inc. and Services FLO Inc. These agreements were initially approved by the Board on December 12, 2022, as an extension of a City of Toronto agreement with the cooperative purchasing organization, Kinetic GPO that was tendered in the fall of 2022 and remains in effect today. The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Provided authority to the President, Toronto Parking Authority, to extend the EV Charging Equipment Purchase Agreement effective December 12, 2022, with Services FLO Inc., for an additional term of two (2) years plus an additional one (1) year option at Toronto Parking Authority’s sole discretion. 2. Deferred consideration of the extension of the EV Charging Equipment Purchase Agreement effective December 12, 2022, with ChargePoint Inc., for an additional term of two (2) years plus an additional one (1) year option at Toronto Parking Authority’s sole discretion to the May 15, 2025 meeting of Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority. 3.
